title: Conditioning Hourly Rate by Appointment Series Format — Work Conditioning and Work Hardening
content:
# Conditioning hourly rate by series format

Program days of the Work Conditioning Program and the Work Hardening Program under a Workers' Compensation Referral are booked in an Appointment Series funded by the referral. The format of that Appointment Series sets the conditioning hourly rate.

**Rate rule.** The conditioning hourly rate is seventy-two dollars ($72.00) where the appointment series funded by the referral is a Specialty One-on-One Visit Series, sixty-eight dollars ($68.00) where it is an Extended 60-Minute Visit Series, and the program's hourly unit rate for any other series format.

| Format of the Appointment Series funded by the referral | Conditioning hourly rate |
|---|---|
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | $72.00 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | $68.00 |
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | the program's hourly unit rate |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | the program's hourly unit rate |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | the program's hourly unit rate |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | the program's hourly unit rate |

The series that counts is the Appointment Series whose funding is this workers' compensation referral; its format is read from that series record.

## Case (hypothetical)

A Work Conditioning Program referral funds a Specialty One-on-One Visit Series. Each conditioning hour of its program days is priced at $72.00; three conditioning hours come to $216.00 at that rate.
